requestBody.transport: Legacy CLI -body or optional -body-stdin; Tauri uses stdin so JSON is not limited by Windows command-line length
requestBody.rules: Selected stdin and explicitly supplied -body (including empty) are mutually exclusive; read through EOF with maxBytes+1 sentinel, reject oversize or read errors before HTTP; preserve the exact accepted UTF-8 body and existing authentication/origin/idempotency policy

response.headers: optional object of lowercase allowlisted pagination header values

responseLimits.rules: General envelope budget is 6 * (httpBodyMaxBytes + metadataReserveBytes). Five allowlisted pagination values each at most4096 UTF-8 bytes plus fixed key/status/envelope bytes fit the reserve; reject oversized allowed metadata explicitly, never truncate/drop a continuation cursor. Content-Type/private response headers are not forwarded. Preview remains a single256KiB JPEG in JSON/base64 under its existing512KiB envelope. HTTP/body limits and credentials/origin/idempotency remain unchanged

paginationHeaderRules: Preserve nonempty allowlisted values within the byte bound; reject an oversized allowed value before emitting any stdout envelope, never truncate/drop continuation metadata or return a partial map; credentials and other headers remain excluded
printerSharing: Default cloud printer pages exclude sharedWithGateway:false before pagination. Private local queues stay visible through the separate native Agent list; protected local share mutation and heartbeat/admission semantics are defined in printer-sharing-contract.json.
fleetQueryRules: GET only; one nonempty value per key; reject unknown keys, malformed escapes, encoded routes, fragments and traversal
cursorRules: When x-has-more=true, advance with x-next-before-created-at plus x-next-before-id-encoded (beforeIdEncoded query), falling back to x-next-before-id; advance even when a page body is empty after virtual-printer filtering
credentials: paired Agent credentials stay inside the CLI; no Authorization, Set-Cookie or secret response headers cross the desktop bridge
